notes.title: UPDATE 0.2
notes.notes:
[b]hot fix 0.2[/b]

- fixed more build part collision so should be able to place furniture items
- fixed cook up station not spawning in when crafted
- foliage respawn times (specifically iron ore)
- fixed furnace not being available at the crafting bench
- furnace crafting cost
- added more storage to crafting bench
- fixed cooking station
- there is now a kill zone under the map if you choose to jump off lol
- water now depletes at a much slower rate
- terrain around hangers is now flat so buildings dont hang off edge
- weapon spawning probability has changed
- generator build collision has been adjusted again
- tweaked generator proximity

notes.title: UPDATE 0.1
notes.notes:
[b]hot fix 0.1[/b]

- storage no longer requires generator
- generator no longer requires generator to craft its self
- pills can now be stack up to 15 each
- bandages can now be stacked up to 15 each
- fixed death rose collison, should now be able to pick up
- increased battery spawn probability
- iron nodes will now give stone and iron until the procedural spawning probability is fixed
